design_change.reason: The project objective is operational forecasting validation: inspect the unchanged frozen model continuously on already available and newly arriving market outcomes rather than delay all performance inspection for a single 14-day reveal.
design_change.versioning_rule: Observed monitoring data may guide diagnosis. Any modified model starts a new versioned forward segment and cannot relabel previously observed rows as fresh prospective evidence.

claim_boundary: v0.23 remains a valid engineering demonstration of artifact sealing but is no longer an active confirmatory evidence programme. No v0.23 performance claim was ever produced.
